pr_title: [Refactor][Misc] Remove unused shared expert DP flags
source_quote:
Since `get_ascend_config` is no longer imported or used in `vllm_ascend/ops/mla.py`, any attempt to patch it via **`@patch("vllm_ascend.ops.mla.get_ascend_config")`** will raise an **`AttributeError`** and cause the unit tests to fail.
> Please remove the `@patch("vllm_ascend.ops.mla.get_ascend_config")` **decorators**, their corresponding **`mock_ascend_config` arguments**, and any **unused references to `mock_ascend_config`** from both `test_initialization` and `test_forward` in this file.

diff.unified:
--- a/tests/ut/ops/test_mla.py
+++ b/tests/ut/ops/test_mla.py
@@ -2,20 +2,18 @@
     def setUp(self):
         self.mock_quant_config = MagicMock()
 
-    # test_initialization 装饰器栈（约 L77-L86）
     @patch("vllm_ascend.ops.mla.get_current_vllm_config")
-    @patch("vllm_ascend.ops.mla.get_ascend_config")          # ← 错 1：符号已在 mla.py 整条删除
+    # 删 @patch("vllm_ascend.ops.mla.get_ascend_config")         # ← 删装饰器（错1修复）
     @patch("vllm_ascend.ops.mla.get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size")
-    def test_initialization(self, mock_tp_size, mock_ascend_config, mock_get_vllm_config):
-    #                                               ↑ 错 2：参数与装饰器对应，装饰器删了参数也得删
+    def test_initialization(self, mock_tp_size, mock_get_vllm_config):
+    #                                       ↑ 删 mock_ascend_config 形参（错2修复）
         mock_mla_attn = MagicMock()
         mock_mla_attn.process_weights_after_loading = MagicMock()
         ...
 
-    # test_forward 装饰器栈（约 L110-L125）
     @patch("vllm_ascend.ops.mla.torch.ops.vllm.mla_forward")
     @patch("vllm_ascend.ops.mla.get_current_vllm_config")
-    @patch("vllm_ascend.ops.mla.get_ascend_config")      # ← 错 3：同上，forward 也残留
+    # 删 @patch("vllm_ascend.ops.mla.get_ascend_config")         # ← 删装饰器（错3修复）
     @patch("vllm_ascend.ops.mla.get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size")
     @patch("vllm_ascend.ops.mla.get_forward_context")
     @patch("vllm_ascend.ascend_forward_context.get_forward_context")
@@ -24,12 +22,12 @@
         mock_get_forward_context_2,
         mock_get_forward_context,
         mock_tp_size,
-        mock_ascend_config,                               # ← 错 4：forward 也残留 mock 形参
+        # 删 mock_ascend_config,                                  # ← 删 forward 形参（错4修复）
         mock_get_vllm_config,
         mock_mla_forward,
     ):
         mock_tp_size.return_value = 1
-        mock_ascend_config.return_value.enable_shared_expert_dp = False    # ← 错 5：deprecated flag
+        # 删 mock_ascend_config.return_value.enable_shared_expert_dp = False  # ← 删实体赋值（错5修复）
         mock_vllm_config = MagicMock(spec=VllmConfig)
         mock_vllm_config.model_config.hf_text_config = MagicMock(
             num_hidden_layers=32, first_k_dense_replace=False)
